findings.observed: Budget documents a separate OS coordinator; no OS runtime is available and group ownership is unconfirmed.
findings.next: Assign persistent OS/Saga state, timeouts and reconciliation to a named service.

findings.observed: Infra-broker proposes gearflow.events topic and eventType/data wrapper. Operation retains the native MassTransit envelope but now maps its 13 published events to operation.<fact> fanout exchanges without version suffix. Command queues and wire URNs remain unchanged; Inventory was not modified.
findings.next: Agree envelope, explicit event entity names, durable subscriber bindings and ACL; update consumer configuration before enabling the Operation dispatcher. No shared infrastructure was modified.

findings.observed: Budget flow assigns reservation/final stock update to Execution; Inventory implements ReserveStock/ReleaseStock/ConsumeStock. Operation does not own stock.
findings.next: Revise Budget diagram with Inventory and explicit acknowledgement of stock consumption.

findings.observed: Budget flow pays before reservation; Operation reference recommends reservation before payment request.
findings.next: Approve ordering, expiry and compensation policy; require all applicable confirmations before StartExecution.

findings.observed: GET paths and id/name/priceCents or unitPriceCents match the adapter. DTOs have no isActive field; Operation treats it as optional.
findings.next: Test actual Inventory host with service credential and known IDs. Confirm units/rounding.

findings.observed: Inventory requires authenticated JWT; Operation additionally requires a configured Staff claim. No common service identity agreement is available.
findings.next: Define emitter, audience, permissions, expiry and rotation. Do not forward human tokens.

findings.observed: Budget snapshot has README/saga documentation, without executable CLR contracts or schemas. Nine event names are documented; payload/URN compatibility cannot be verified.
findings.next: Budget owner provides canonical typed contracts and examples; do not invent financial payloads in Operation.

findings.observed: Database infrastructure targets phase-3 SQL Server; Operation needs exclusive PostgreSQL. Budget MongoDB is a documented plan, not a verified runtime.
findings.next: Prepare reviewed infrastructure, secrets and connectivity changes. No cloud apply is included in this kit.
